extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors/editors attempting to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance for finding, creating, or troubleshooting a Wikipedia page (searching for existing articles, using the article wizard, checking deletion logs, handling redirects and case-sensitivity, and account requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must be logged in and autoconfirmed before creating new articles on Wikipedia; this is a prerequisite rather than an editorial guideline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create a live article directly, submit a draft via the article wizard or request that an article be created/reviewed by others.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles/spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Late-night talk shows during 2023 strike" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a page, search Wikipedia to avoid duplication and to find existing coverage under different titles or spellings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check what pages link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate incoming links to determine whether content already exists elsewhere or whether a redirect is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newly created pages may be temporarily invisible
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect the page was just created, allow time for database updates or use the purge function to refresh; do not assume absence immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and create redirects when appropriate so readers find the canonical page regardless of minor capitalization differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the deletion log to understand reasons for removal and to determine whether recreation is appropriate or requires addressing issues raised at deletion.
